source.description: Planned six-panel handmade graphite and colored-pencil contact sheet.
source.notes: August 15 current lesson; selected after rejecting the duplicate desk-fan candidate before image generation.

process_strategy: One horizontal glass bottle and a tiny centered sailboat are built from the same light perspective box, then receive the bottle silhouette, boat hull and masts, sails and waterline, glass reflections, restrained color, and final graphite reinforcement without changing the arrangement.

final_elements.name: construction guides
final_elements.description: Pale bottle box, neck axis, hull wedge, two mast routes, waterline, reflection, and shadow reserves.

final_elements.name: glass bottle silhouette
final_elements.description: One horizontal rounded bottle with a short neck, rim ellipse, thick base, and cork.

final_elements.name: sailboat hull and masts
final_elements.description: One small dark hull with two thin masts seated inside the bottle.

final_elements.name: two sails and waterline
final_elements.description: Two simple triangular cream sails above a pale blue waterline inside the bottle.

final_elements.name: glass reflections and color
final_elements.description: Two open-paper reflection shapes, pale blue glass tint, warm cork, and a soft gray shadow.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The bottle waterline and glass shading stop at the planned hull and mast routes.

frames.visible_job: Place one long bottle box, neck axis, hull wedge, two mast routes, waterline, reflection, and shadow reserves in pale graphite.
Connect the guide into one rounded bottle, short neck, rim ellipse, thick base, and cork while preserving the boat reserves.
Draw the established small hull and exactly two thin masts inside the glass.
Add exactly two triangular sails and the established waterline, stopping water marks at the hull.
Add the established reflection gaps, pale blue glass and water tint, warm cork, and soft gray shadow to existing forms.

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthens established graphite contours, glass tint, color, and shadow.

rejection_checks: Reject a bottle, boat, mast, sail, cork, waterline, reflection, or shadow that first appears in the final panel.
Reject changed bottle perspective, boat scale, two-mast count, or two-sail count.
Reject clean vector-looking or polished poster art; retain paper tooth and handmade graphite variation.
